tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Create a voice-first form link that collects human answers and pipes responses back to the agent.

tools.name: create_feedback_form
tools.description: Create a voice-first feedback, cancellation, feature request, survey, or research form with optional smart follow-ups.

tools.name: create_ask
tools.description: Create a voice-first Superforms answer link for human input. Backward-compatible alias for create_form.

tools.name: join_creation_session
tools.description: Join a Superforms homepage creation handoff session before creating the real form. Pass agentName with the client name, such as Codex, Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor.

tools.name: update_creation_session
tools.description: Update a homepage creation handoff draft with the current form title, questions, and settings before the user clicks Set live.

tools.name: get_responses
tools.description: Fetch persisted raw responses for a Superforms ask. This is the MCP equivalent of the HTTP bridge answers endpoint.

tools.name: list_asks
tools.description: List recent asks for a provided private agent token.

tools.name: watch_ask
tools.description: Return as soon as an individual answer is saved, including answers received while an agent was reconnecting and while the form remains in progress. Use since for durable per-answer catch-up; the HTTP bridge also exposes an SSE stream endpoint.

tools.name: list_my_forms
tools.description: List forms owned by the connected Superforms account, including response counts and latest response timestamps.

tools.name: get_my_form_responses
tools.description: Read persisted raw responses for a form owned by the connected Superforms account. No per-form agent token is required.

tools.name: watch_my_form_responses
tools.description: Return any existing individual answers immediately, or wait briefly until the respondent saves their next answer, even while the form remains in progress.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "watch_ask" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Wait briefly for a response, including responses received while an agent was reconnecting. Use since for durable catch-up; the HTTP bridge also exposes an SSE stream endpoint." → after: "Return as soon as an individual answer is saved, including answers received while an agent was reconnecting and while the form remains in progress. Use since for durable per-answer catch-up; the HTTP bridge also exposes an SSE stream endpoint."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "watch_my_form_responses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Wait briefly for new responses to a form owned by the connected Superforms account." → after: "Return any existing individual answers immediately, or wait briefly until the respondent saves their next answer, even while the form remains in progress."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
